prepared_by: Engineering, from the statute text. Every rule is a draft: it applies in a firm only once two of its members have signed its current version (rule_verifications / rule_active). Not checked by advocates.

fields.max_years: maximum term of imprisonment in years (null where the gravest punishment is life or death only)
fields.min_years: minimum term fixed by the section (null where there is none)
fields.life: imprisonment for life is one of the punishments
fields.death: death is one of the punishments
fields.special_statute: NDPS_COMMERCIAL: s. 36A(4) NDPS Act custody periods apply

rules.title: Murder
rules.note: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine.

rules.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (Part I: intention)
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or up to ten years, and fine, where the act is done with intention (first paragraph).

rules.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (Part II: knowledge)
rules.note: Up to ten years, or fine, or both, where the act is done with knowledge but without intention (second paragraph).

rules.title: Causing death by negligence
rules.note: Up to two years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Dowry death
rules.note: Not less than seven years, which may extend to imprisonment for life (s. 304B(2)).

rules.title: Abetment of suicide
rules.note: Up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Attempt to murder (no hurt caused)
rules.note: Up to ten years, and fine. Where hurt is caused, use IPC-307-HURT.

rules.title: Attempt to murder (hurt caused)
rules.note: Where hurt is caused: imprisonment for life, or the punishment in the first paragraph. Death where the offender is under a sentence of imprisonment for life (second paragraph): not modelled here.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
rules.note: Up to one year, or fine up to one thousand rupees, or both.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
rules.note: Up to three years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
rules.note: Not less than one year, up to five years, and fine (as amended in 2013).

rules.title: Kidnapping
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Rape
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years, which may extend to imprisonment for life, and fine (minimum raised from seven to ten years for offences from 21 April 2018). Aggravated forms (s. 376(2), (3), 376A, 376AB, 376DA, 376DB) carry higher minimums or death: not modelled here.

rules.title: Gang rape
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than twenty years, which may extend to life (the remainder of natural life), and fine.

rules.title: Theft
rules.note: Up to three years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Theft in dwelling house, etc.
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Robbery
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Robbery on a highway between sunset and sunrise
rules.note: Up to fourteen years where committed on the highway between sunset and sunrise.

rules.title: Dacoity
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Criminal breach of trust
rules.note: Up to three years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc.
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Forgery for the purpose of cheating
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
rules.note: Up to three years, and fine.

rules.title: Criminal intimidation
rules.note: Up to two years, or fine, or both (first paragraph).

rules.title: Criminal intimidation: threat to cause death or grievous hurt, etc.
rules.note: Up to seven years, or fine, or both (second paragraph).

rules.title: Murder
rules.note: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine.

rules.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (intention)
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or not less than five years up to ten years, and fine, where the act is done with intention (first part).

rules.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (knowledge)
rules.note: Up to ten years, and fine, where the act is done with knowledge but without intention (second part).

rules.title: Causing death by negligence
rules.note: Up to five years, and fine (up to two years for a registered medical practitioner during a medical procedure).

rules.title: Dowry death
rules.note: Not less than seven years, which may extend to imprisonment for life.

rules.title: Abetment of suicide
rules.note: Up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Attempt to murder (no hurt caused)
rules.note: Up to ten years, and fine. Where hurt is caused, use BNS-109(1)-HURT.

rules.title: Attempt to murder (hurt caused)
rules.note: Where hurt is caused: imprisonment for life, or the punishment above. Death or life (remainder of natural life) under s. 109(2) for a life convict: not modelled here.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
rules.note: Up to one year, or fine up to ten thousand rupees, or both.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
rules.note: Up to three years, or fine up to twenty thousand rupees, or both.

rules.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or not less than one year up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
rules.note: Not less than one year, up to five years, and fine.

rules.title: Kidnapping
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Rape
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years, which may extend to imprisonment for life, and fine. Aggravated forms (s. 64(2), 65, 66, 70(2)) carry higher minimums or death: not modelled here.

rules.title: Gang rape
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than twenty years, which may extend to life (the remainder of natural life), and fine.

rules.title: Theft
rules.note: Up to three years, or fine, or both. A second or subsequent conviction: rigorous imprisonment not less than one year up to five years, and fine (proviso): not modelled here.

rules.title: Theft in a dwelling house, means of transportation or place of worship, etc.
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Robbery
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Robbery on a highway between sunset and sunrise
rules.note: Up to fourteen years where committed on the highway between sunset and sunrise.

rules.title: Dacoity
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Criminal breach of trust
rules.note: Up to five years, or fine, or both (three years under s. 406 IPC).

rules.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc.
rules.note: Imprisonment for life, or up to ten years, and fine.

rules.title: Forgery for the purpose of cheating
rules.note: Up to seven years, and fine.

rules.title: Cruelty by husband or relative of husband
rules.note: Up to three years, and fine.

rules.title: Criminal intimidation
rules.note: Up to two years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Criminal intimidation: threat to cause death or grievous hurt, etc.
rules.note: Up to seven years, or fine, or both.

rules.title: Manufactured drugs: small quantity
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment up to one year, or fine up to ten thousand rupees, or both.

rules.title: Manufactured drugs: more than small, less than commercial quantity
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment up to ten years, and fine up to one lakh rupees.

rules.title: Manufactured drugs: commercial quantity
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years up to twenty years, and fine of one to two lakh rupees.

rules.title: Psychotropic substances: commercial quantity
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years up to twenty years, and fine of one to two lakh rupees.

rules.title: Cannabis: commercial quantity
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years up to twenty years, and fine of one to two lakh rupees.

rules.title: Financing illicit traffic and harbouring offenders
rules.note: Rigorous imprisonment not less than ten years up to twenty years, and fine of one to two lakh rupees. s. 36A(4) applies to s. 27A offences.

rules.title: NDPS: investigation period for ss. 19, 24, 27A and commercial quantity
rules.note: The 90 days in the default-bail provision are read as 180 days; the Special Court may extend the period up to one year on the Public Prosecutor's report. The extension is applied only when the extension order's date is entered.

rules.title: UAPA: investigation period
rules.basis: Section 43D(2) of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967
rules.note: For UAPA offences both default-bail periods are read as 90 days; the Court may extend the period up to 180 days on the Public Prosecutor's report. The extension is applied only when the extension order's date is entered. The citation registry (citation_service.ACTS) does not list the UAPA yet, so this basis checks as 'unverified' there.
